title: Cooperative CSV rerun stop and continue
summary: Added cooperative CSV rerun stop-after-current control and pending-only continuation through backend-owned routes, PowerShell stop markers, manifest evidence, and Launch/Rerun Results UI actions.
reason: Operators needed a clear way to stop a long CSV rerun after the current row/window, restart the desktop application if needed, and continue only rows still marked pending without retrying failed/review rows or changing media policy.
behavior_before: Stop After Current used the generic pipeline control path and CSV rerun manifests had no stopped-after-current terminal state or backend-scoped pending-only continuation flow.
behavior_after: Active CSV reruns route Stop After Current to /api/rerun/control, PowerShell stops only after chunk completion with stopped_after_current evidence, and stopped manifests with pending rows expose Continue Pending Rows through /api/rerun/continue.

rollback_plan: Remove the rerun control/continue routes, strict payload classes, rerun_control helper, facade wiring, stopped-after-current result fields, Launch UI routing/actions, PowerShell stop-marker handling, focused tests, inventory updates, and generated summaries. Runtime stop markers and scoped continuation CSVs under LocalBase State\Rerun can be left as inert evidence or deleted after confirming no active rerun.
